basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/SecurityScorecard%20Cybersecurity%20Ratings%20V2/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. The [SecurityScorecard](https://securityscorecard.com) Cybersecurity Ratings V2 solution provides three Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) data connectors that ingest daily cybersecurity ratings data from the SecurityScorecard API into Microsoft Sentinel. **Connectors included:** - **SecurityScorecard Ratings** — Daily overall score history for every company in a monitored portfolio (`/companies/{domain}/history/score`). - **SecurityScorecard Issues** — Daily security issue and event history, recording when issues appear, change severity, or resolve (`/companies/{domain}/history/events`). - **SecurityScorecard Factor Scores** — Daily per-factor scores across 10 security categories (DNS Health, IP Reputation, Network Security, Application Security, Patching Cadence, Endpoint Security, Social Engineering, Hacker Chatter, Leaked Information, Cubit Score) for every portfolio company (`/companies/{domain}/history/factors/score`). All three connectors discover monitored companies automatically from a specified SecurityScorecard portfolio, requiring only an API key and portfolio ID at setup time. **Data Connectors:** 3 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)
